counterfactual.change: halved dt from 0.01729 to 0.008646 (single field) to increase substep resolution; this allows corner contact detection and eliminates penetration

explanation: Body grazes the top corner of a thin (0.3 wide) vertical wall with high downward velocity (~7 m/s). With dt=0.017s (5 substeps, ~0.0034s substep) the collision detector fails to generate a contact for the side/corner penetration; distance_to_surface goes from +0.09 at step32 to -0.032 at step33 to -0.156 at step34 without impulse correction, exceeding the 0.15 penetration allowance. Halving dt provides sufficient substep resolution to detect the contact and prevent penetration.
vision_note: The red circular body falls straight down onto the top of a thin vertical grey wall. In steps 31-33 it sits just above the wall tip, then in step 34 it visibly sinks into and overlaps the wall instead of bouncing or resting on top.
